feedback: Add separate DataUse records for the external sources used in the analysis: German official statistics used for sampling quotas and representativeness (DOCUMENTARY_SOURCE, DOCUMENT), the published EQ-5D-5L crosswalk values (PUBLISHED_MODEL_INPUT, AGGREGATE_ESTIMATE), and the published German EQ-5D-3L values (PUBLISHED_MODEL_INPUT, AGGREGATE_ESTIMATE). Link the latter two to the value-set comparison. Add the reported Tobit homoskedasticity test as a MethodUse with DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY and QUANTITATIVE_ANALYSIS; it caused the selection of the heteroskedastic Model 3b. Keep the existing Study, family, instruments, principal results, and part-level gap.

Correct the provenance of the test-retest data. Create separable initial-test and retest StudyParts. The initial OPUF responses came from the previously reported validation study and must use PRIOR_RESEARCH_COLLECTION; the newly collected two-week retest responses must use CURRENT_STUDY_COLLECTION. Split du1 and all other wave-specific health, demographic, and feedback DataUses by occasion and assign them to the correct part. Keep the longitudinal, within-person design at study level. Change o1, o2, and o4 from MEASUREMENT_PROPERTY to METHOD_PERFORMANCE_OR_DATA_QUALITY because the principal results concern the reliability of the OPUF valuation method, not the measurement properties of EQ-HWB-S. Keep EQ-HWB-S as the valuation target and health-state description instrument. Add the reported limitation that the study cannot determine whether the observed unreliability is caused by OPUF, EQ-HWB-S complexity, or online administration. Link this limitation to the method, instrument, and online survey software.

Add a current-study MethodUse for “International Classification of Diseases, 11th Revision (ICD-11)” to represent its use in classifying study samples into disease groups; use EVIDENCE_SYNTHESIS as the closest available method function and link it to sf2. Expand f9 to state that no relevant studies were found for the Philippines as well as AQOL and 15D. Do not add the Philippines to pop1 or sf1 because those records describe populations represented in the included evidence.

Add a SourceConflict for the principal overall ceiling-effect result. Preserve both the narrative claim of a 9% reduction and Table 3’s 44%-to-46% increase, and also record the 129-versus-128 inconsistency in the EQ-5D-Y-3L counts. Add a separate SourceConflict for the inconsistent EQ-VAS missing-response totals in Table 2. Keep f2 because its child and adolescent comparisons are supported, but do not infer an unconflicted overall direction. In a1–a4, clear the assistance field or state that completion assistance was not reported; distribution and collection of forms are study logistics, not respondent assistance. Do not apply the stated post-EQ administration order to iu5 because the source gives this order only for PedsQL; either remove iu5 from a3 and a4 or represent it in administrations with an unspecified sequence. Add the authors’ limited African generalizability statement as a Limitation.
